subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Is the existing attempt callback field a shipped compatibility contract that must remain, or should this internal helper move directly to the canonical apiKeyIndex and attemptNumber fields?
rationale: Repository policy discourages internal compatibility aliases, while changing a genuinely shipped callback contract requires an explicit deprecation decision; the PR does not establish which boundary applies.

options.title: Use the canonical internal contract
options.body: Remove the deprecated attempt alias, migrate all repository callers to apiKeyIndex or attemptNumber, and prove no supported plugin-sdk surface exposes the old field.

options.title: Approve an additive compatibility contract
options.body: Retain attempt as a documented key-index alias with focused compatibility tests and a named deprecation or permanence decision.

recommendation.title: Use the canonical internal contract
recommendation.body: Remove the deprecated attempt alias, migrate all repository callers to apiKeyIndex or attemptNumber, and prove no supported plugin-sdk surface exposes the old field.
